title: 第10章 导演，加钱-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    韩小汐猛地抬头，沈珩一身红衣官服从她身边走过，站定。

    正好隔在了她和于清中间。

    “导演，降降火，走戏了！”沈珩还特意招过田馨，“晚凝，本官这身朝服如何？”

    “哈哈！沈老师穿什么都好看！”田馨笑盈盈的走过来搭腔。

    于清的火气来得快去的快，挥着手要韩小汐赶紧去准备，然后就开始跟男女主对戏。

    态度专业认真，仿佛刚刚那个怒吼小替身的不是他似的。

    他又帮了她一次。

    韩小汐感激地看了沈珩一眼，不过他连一个眼神都没给她。

    在人群中谈笑风生。

    韩小汐其实没什么好准备的，只需要洗干净手，套上一件和女主一样的外衫即可。

    化妆师看了半天说，“手比田老师白，不用打底。”

    沈轩倒是不知道从哪里摸了过来，“于导就这样，火药桶一个，全剧组估计只有沈老师没被骂过。”

    “谢谢小沈老师。”韩小汐确实有被安慰道。

    “哈哈！我可担不起这声小沈老师~”沈轩的笑声清爽干净，“走吧，待会儿也有我的戏份。”

    他和她一起去片场。

    韩小汐还是没法将这个阳光大男孩和后世的顶着“小沈老师”头衔爆红的顶流当成同一个人。

    差太多了！

    不过，不知道他和沈珩到底有没有关系，后世有各种传闻。

    有传是兄弟，也有传是叔侄。

    当然也有人说他们没关系。

    只是两人从来没有谁正面回答过这个问题。

    ……

    被于导喷的时候，韩小汐没觉得有什么，不过这会儿等戏等了一个小时，她有些不淡定了。

    这特么叫急？！

    沈轩抱着手机在玩飞机大战，抽空看了她一眼，“习惯就好。”

    韩小汐：……

    干脆溜到自己的工具包那边摸出了手账本。

    没什么比画画更能消磨时间。

    今天的戏份全是文戏，有主角一大家子开会的，有男主在书房议事的，也有男女主花前月下的。

    韩小汐等的这场戏，则是男主下朝回来陪女主画画。

    道具是早前就准备好的，不需要现场画。

    ……

    韩小汐看着片场那抹艳红色身影，不由自主地被吸引。

    印象当中的沈珩几乎都是很低调的穿着。

    难怪有人说三十岁的沈珩才是颜值巅峰。

    就这副俊朗的儒生扮相，她是公主她也愿意嫁！

    看得痴迷，手里下意识地便画了出来。

    寥寥数笔，勾出了一个Q版的大学士。

    还很恶趣味的给画上的小人点了一颗泪痣。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Han Xiaoxi raised her head suddenly, and Shen Heng, dressed in red official uniform, walked past her and stood still.

It happened to be between her and Yu Qing.

"Director, Jiang Jianghuo, it's time to leave the show!" Shen Heng also specially called Tian Xin, "Wan Ning, how do you think of this court uniform?"

"Haha! Teacher Shen looks good in anything she wears!" Tian Xin walked over to chat with him with a smile.

Yu Qing’s anger came and went quickly. He waved his hand to Han Xiaoxi to get ready quickly, and then started to play with the male and female protagonists.

His attitude was professional and serious, as if the person who yelled at the stuntman just now was not him.

He helped her again.

Han Xiaoxi glanced at Shen Heng gratefully, but he didn't even give her a look.

Talking and laughing among the crowd.

Han Xiaoxi actually had nothing to prepare, she just needed to wash her hands and put on a jacket that was the same as the heroine’s.

The makeup artist looked at it for a long time and said, “My hands are whiter than Teacher Tian’s, so there’s no need for primer.”

Shen Xuan didn't know where he came from, "Director Yu is just like this, a powder keg. I think Teacher Shen is the only one in the whole crew who has never been scolded."

"Thank you, Teacher Xiao Shen." Han Xiaoxi was indeed comforted.

"Haha! I can't afford this little teacher Shen~" Shen Xuan's laughter was refreshing and clean, "Let's go, I will have a role later."

He went to the set with her.

Han Xiaoxi still couldn't think of this sunny boy as the same person as the later celebrity who became famous with the title of "Teacher Xiao Shen".

There is a big difference!

"However, I don't know if he and Shen Heng are related. There are various rumors in later generations.

Some say they are brothers, others say they are uncles and nephews.

Of course, some people say they are okay.

It’s just that neither of them has ever answered this question directly.

……

When she was being teased by Yu, Han Xiaoxi didn't think anything was wrong, but after waiting for an hour for the show, she was a little uneasy.

How urgent is this?!

Shen Xuan was holding his cell phone while playing Airplane Battle. He took a moment to look at her and said, "Just get used to it."

Han Xiaoxi:......

He simply slipped over to his tool bag and took out the ledger.

There is nothing better than drawing to kill time.

Today’s scenes are all literary dramas. There are scenes where the protagonist and his family are having a meeting, there are scenes where the male protagonist is discussing matters in the study, and there are also scenes where the male and female protagonists spend time together.

In the scene where Han Xiaoxi and others are waiting, the male protagonist comes back from court to accompany the female protagonist to paint.

The props are prepared in advance and do not need to be painted on site.

……

Han Xiaoxi looked at the bright red figure on the set and was involuntarily attracted.

In my impression, Shen Heng almost always wears very low-key clothes.

No wonder some people say that thirty-year-old Shen Heng is at the peak of his appearance.

With this handsome Confucian appearance, she is willing to marry even if she is a princess!

I was so fascinated by it that I drew it subconsciously.

With a few strokes, a Q-version of a bachelor was drawn.

In a very naughty way, I added a tear mole to the little figure in the painting.

title_en: Chapter 10 Director, more money - "Time Travel 2006 Little Hand Substitute Being Chased and Pampered by the Best Actor"
